title: Padding preserves one machine step
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $K$ satisfy $k\le K$, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. One step of the machine padded to $K$ work tapes, starting from the padded configuration, yields the padding of the configuration obtained from $c$ by one step of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
